tuition_model.notes: Fact Sheet p.2 states exchange students are exempt from university tuition fees, though mandatory semester ticket and social fees still apply.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Official FU Berlin Cairo FAQ lists minimum 934 EUR/month (rental fees, groceries, leisure). AY 2026-2027 Fact Sheet (#page=2,#page=3) separately cites ERG housing 500-1,200 EUR/month, student health insurance ~150 EUR/month (under age 30), and mandatory semester/social fees ~310 EUR/semester; German federal student visa blocked-account threshold is 992 EUR/month.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: Converted from FU Berlin official minimum monthly estimate of 934 EUR over 5 months: 934 EUR * 5 * FX rate 1.1052 USD/EUR = 5,161.28 USD. FX rate 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD from ECB Euro reference exchange rates for 2026-11-13 (latest prior to 2026-11-15), retrieved 2026-11-15 at https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Exempt from university tuition; mandatory semester ticket and social fees ~310 EUR/semester (paid prior to arrival). Mandatory comprehensive German health insurance required for enrollment and residence permit (~150 EUR/month for students under age 30 via German public student insurance; external waivers rarely accepted unless EHIC/GHIC or unlimited coverage).
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/FUBerlin/26-27/Fact Sheet Direct Exchange Program FU Berlin academic year 2026-2027.pdf#page=2

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/FUBerlin/26-27/Fact Sheet Direct Exchange Program FU Berlin academic year 2026-2027.pdf#page=3

housing_notes.value: No on-campus accommodation available (per AY 2025-2026 Fact Sheet #page=3). Students may arrange private housing (e.g., WG shared flats) or apply via FU Berlin's ERG Accommodation Service (dorms, shared apartments, furnished single apartments; ~500-1,200 EUR/month). First-come, first-served; mandatory online registration deadlines June 10 (Winter term) and December 10 (Summer term).
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/FUBerlin/26-27/Fact Sheet Direct Exchange Program FU Berlin academic year 2026-2027.pdf#page=3
housing_notes.notes: ERG Accommodation Service options, ~500-1,200 EUR/month range, and June 10 / Dec 10 registration deadlines from AY 2026-2027 Fact Sheet #page=3; 'no on-campus accommodation available' corroborated in data/raw/factsheets/FUBerlin/2024-2025/Fact Sheet Direct Exchange Program FU Berlin academic year 2025-2026.pdf#page=3.

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: PROMOS/DAAD links found via web search apply to outgoing FU Berlin students; no incoming host stipend confirmed for AUC Direct Exchange.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU/EEA/non-exempt nationals (incl. Egypt) must obtain a German student visa prior to arrival (processing takes at least 8 weeks, up to several months, per Fact Sheet #page=2). After arrival, non-EU students apply for a Berlin residence permit (Aufenthaltserlaubnis) via LEA/FU Pass-Service (typically 8 to 14 weeks processing). Financial proof (e.g., blocked account / Sperrkonto) required per German Federal Foreign Office standard (992 EUR/month / 11,904 EUR/year; FU Berlin general FAQ lists >=934 EUR/month).
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/FUBerlin/26-27/Fact Sheet Direct Exchange Program FU Berlin academic year 2026-2027.pdf#page=2
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Pre-arrival entry visa requirement & >=8 weeks visa processing from AY 2026-2027 Fact Sheet #page=2; Berlin residence permit 8-14 week timeline from https://www.fu-berlin.de/en/studium/international/studium_fu/einreise_aufenthalt/aufenthaltserlaubnis/index.html; blocked account 992 EUR/mo (11,904 EUR/yr) from https://www.auswaertiges-amt.de/en/sperrkonto/388600; FU >=934 EUR/mo baseline from https://www.fu-berlin.de/en/sites/cairo/faq/faq-study/living-costs/index.html.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS (Leistungspunkte/LP); regular full-time workload is 30 ECTS per semester (FU recommends 10-30 ECTS for exchange students; no strict host minimum). Grading scale (except Law): 1.0-1.5 very good, 1.6-2.5 good, 2.6-3.5 satisfactory, 3.5-4.0 sufficient, 5.0 fail.

credit_system_and_load.notes: Grading scale table detailed on Fact Sheet p.4.

course_restrictions_note.value: Human Medicine, Veterinary Medicine, and fee-based continuing education Master's programs are closed. Biochemistry, bioinformatics, and biology depend on lab availability and prior departmental approval; restrictions apply in Pharmacy, Law (prefers reciprocal Law exchange partners), and Business & Economics (requires B2+ German; very limited irregular English offerings). Master's courses other than Modern German Literature, Philosophy, and Political Science require prior departmental approval; BA students generally cannot take Master's courses. Cross-registration at HU Berlin, TU Berlin, and University of Potsdam possible with prior lecturer approval.
